issues: src/pages/Home.tsx: The hero "Book a consultation" button is rendered as a <Link> with role="button", causing the test to not find a link with name "Book a consultation". Change the <Link> to have the default link role (remove the role attribute or set role="link") so that getByRole('link', { name: /book a consultation/i }) succeeds. Optionally remove the extra <button> element that also renders "Explore services", as it is unnecessary and may confuse the UI.
feedback: The failing acceptance test expects the hero CTA "Book a consultation" to be a link role, but the implementation marks it as a button role. Adjust the component to match the test's expectation.
